Join Veggie Paaji for Part 2 of the Patna Night Street Food series (Bihar EP 6) as we explore the famous Maurya Lok Khau Gali! This bustling food lane, now located on the backside of the Patna Museum [00:53, 04:58], comes alive at night with incredible local flavors.
Featured in this food adventure:
• R.K Litti: We start with Patna's iconic Litti Chokha [02:55], available even at midnight [00:00, 02:41]! These hot, coal-roasted littis are soaked in ghee and served with a spicy chokha and a unique mustard-peanut chutney [02:06, 03:15].
• Location: R.K LITTI (Near Patna Museum, Maurya Lok)
